name: pir2-academy-sheets-reader
description: Read Google Sheets through learner-owned OAuth for PiR2 Academy dashboards.
long_description: A local, read-only Google Sheets MCP server for the Advanced Claude CoWork course. Each learner connects a Google Cloud Desktop OAuth client that they own. Tokens stay in the operating system credential vault.

google_oauth_credentials_file.title: Google Desktop OAuth credentials
google_oauth_credentials_file.description: Select the credentials JSON downloaded from your own Google Cloud project.

tools.name: google_auth_status
tools.description: Check whether Google Sheets OAuth is connected.

tools.name: connect_google
tools.description: Connect the learner's Google account with read-only Sheets access.

tools.name: get_spreadsheet_metadata
tools.description: Read spreadsheet title and sheet metadata without cell values.

tools.name: read_sheet_sample
tools.description: Read a bounded sample so Claude can understand a sheet safely.

tools.name: read_sheet_ranges
tools.description: Read one or more bounded A1 ranges from a spreadsheet.
